summary.text: Nancy Lee Peterson is an Unaffiliated write-in candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 57, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the incumbent is Republican Nelson Abbott.
Peterson is a retired professor who, in a Ballotpedia survey, said she spent her career at Utah Valley University and has lived in Orem for 29 years.

paragraphs.text: Peterson earned a high school diploma from Burlington High School, a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 1980, a graduate degree from Old Dominion University in 1994, and a degree from the University of Virginia in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as a professor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her career at Utah Valley University began when it was growing from a technical school and two-year college into a four-year university, and that she has been retired for four years.
Peterson said she has served on the Orem Arts Council and donated platelets through the Red Cross.

She said she is running to offer voters a meaningful choice, noting that unopposed incumbents can remain unknown to the community, and that she wants to prevent national political anger from affecting state government.
